instruction:
Fix the native Altium board `C:\Users\user\Desktop\broken_pcie_diffpair_rules.PcbDoc` and save the repaired document as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\pcie_diffpair_rules.PcbDoc`. To use Altium Designer on Windows, run `D:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE` (adjust if your install path differs).

Restore the `PCIE_85` differential-pair class with members `PCIE_TX7` and `PCIE_TX7_C`. Restore the enabled priority-1 `DiffPairsRouting_PCIE_85` rule with `MAXLIMIT=15mil`, `MOSTFREQGAP=5mil`, top-layer gap `4.7244mil`, and top-layer width range `3.937mil` to `5.9055mil` with preferred width `5.9055mil`. Restore the enabled priority-3 `MatchedLengths_PCIE_RX_TX_TX_C_CLK` rule with `TOLERANCE=5.1181mil`, `CHECKNETSINDIFFPAIR=TRUE`, and all other checking flags set to `FALSE`. Remove the damaged `PCIE_90`, `25mil`, `9mil`, and `9.9999mil` settings.
